stem: What can the reader infer about Carl from this excerpt?

options.label: F
options.text: Carl thinks that what Mike is saying isn’t important.

options.label: G
options.text: Carl doesn’t believe that the traffic was bad.

options.label: H
options.text: Carl envies Mike for being a Ranger Scout.

options.label: J
options.text: Carl thinks that Mike has been rude to Mrs. Watson.

visual_elements: MIKE: [Nods eagerly.] My dad was taking me to Ranger Scouts last night, and the traffic was bad.
